question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
check_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 0 YEAR as check_date_0,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 2 YEAR as check_date_2,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 4 YEAR as check_date_4,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 6 YEAR as check_date_6,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 8 YEAR as check_date_8,
        DATE(ft.first_term_start) + INTERVAL 10 YEAR as check_date_10
    FROM first_terms ft
),
serving_status AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.id_bioguide,
        cd.gender,
        cd.state,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_0 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_0,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_2 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_2,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_4 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_4,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_6 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_6,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_8 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_8,
        CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date_10 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > cd.check_date_10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_10
    FROM check_dates cd
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON cd.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        MAX(retained_0) as has_retained_0,
        MAX(retained_2) as has_retained_2,
        MAX(retained_4) as has_retained_4,
        MAX(retained_6) as has_retained_6,
        MAX(retained_8) as has_retained_8,
        MAX(retained_10) as has_retained_10
    FROM serving_status
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
male_qualifying AS (
    SELECT state FROM retention_by_state_gender 
    WHERE gender = 'M' 
      AND has_retained_0 = 1 AND has_retained_2 = 1 AND has_retained_4 = 1 AND has_retained_6 = 1 AND has_retained_8 = 1 AND has_retained_10 = 1
),
female_qualifying AS (
    SELECT state FROM retention_by_state_gender 
    WHERE gender = 'F' 
      AND has_retained_0 = 1 AND has_retained_2 = 1 AND has_retained_4 = 1 AND has_retained_6 = 1 AND has_retained_8 = 1 AND has_retained_10 = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT mq.state
FROM male_qualifying mq
INNER JOIN female_qualifying fq ON mq.state = fq.state
ORDER BY mq.state
